device.type: DVB-S2 Full HD H.265/HEVC compact satellite receiver with built-in Wi-Fi
device.board: 73010A00 (bootloader version "3510DB 1.1.1", 128 MB DDR3 single-CPU C3503D platform)
device.soc: ALi M3510D / C3503D (chip word 0x3503D000, SDK chip code 0x10051, bootloader "chip_id: HW_TYPE_CHIP+83; product_id 0.", Libcore 17.15.0@SDK4.0ia.17.15_20171115)

panel.chip: CH455 (TM1650-compatible, driven on external IR/LED sensor pins)

source.note: Archive AMIKO MIRA WIFI 2 Edision_v.1231.zip from the Amiko/Amiko HD folder on satedu.cba.pl; fetched 2026-11-02.

simulator.note: Boots as the single-CPU C3503 family (chips/c3503.py, chip word 0x3503D000, run_dump_mira2_wifi_edision_app_starts.py, run_dump_mira2_wifi_edision_capture_screen.py): the boot-ROM SRAM bootloader ("3510DB 1.1.1") copies itself to 0x81000000, writes " ON " to the CH455 panel bus on GPIO 24 (SCL) / 23 (SDA), verifies the CRC of maincode(AV), unpacks 12.51 MB (0xC83F64 bytes) to 0x80000200 and enters the application (CP0 EBase 0x80002000).  Unlike v1.2.35, this build retains maincode UART logging ("---led 455 attach OK--", "Starting mcas v.1.0 compiled Jul  1 2020 14:23:02"), updates its CH455 4-digit LED panel on GPIO 24 / 23 to " on ", unpacks defaultdb(PRC) into userdb(64+64), and draws its 4-colour 1280x720 CLUT8 OSD dialog through GeM36F / GMA layer 0 (9 GE commands).

desc: Amiko Mira2 WiFi Edision GUI firmware v.1231 (System ID 73010A00, compiled 2020-07-01) for the compact Full HD H.265/HEVC DVB-S2 satellite receiver with built-in Wi-Fi on the single-CPU ALi M3510D / C3503D SoC (128 MB DDR3, 8 MB SPI flash).
Uses a CH455 (TM1650-compatible) 4-digit LED panel on GPIO 24 / 23, retains full application UART logging, and uses the Amiko / Edision 0x60xx remote control table ("necfirst" coding).
